title: Surreal Clock Landscape
description: A large circular surreal landscape features a prominent clock tower with Roman numerals built into a green rolling hill with a winding stream. The scene is surrounded by floating colorful spheres, butterflies, bats, a star, and a small cross atop the tower, all set against a pale beige background.
prompt: A surreal circular composition showing a detailed green hilly landscape with a stream and trees, featuring a tall clock tower with a large white clock face showing Roman numerals and black hands at approximately 4:55, a small white sphere and cross on top of the tower, various floating elements around the circle including colorful spheres, butterflies, bats, a star, and a small red planet-like object, all rendered in a detailed illustrative painting style with soft lighting and a pale beige background.
